name: Edit like an editor
description: Use when someone wants a video edited in Kriya's Editing Studio: brief first, a recipe makes the cut, read the checks, change one thing at a time, and never promise what the checks didn't confirm.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: Edit my video into something I can post
Use the editing studio to cut the video down
Edit the config file to add a port
